turns.content: Album Out Loud for my uncle, he has low vision. Album Christmas.

Album Out Loud setup. Reply go, or change any line.
1. Album or photo folder: Christmas
2. For: your uncle, in English
3. Detail: brief, one AI sentence per photo. Say rich for up to three sentences per photo.
4. Photos: 6, at most 10
5. Family notes signed by: the family
6. Letter: new

I read only this album and your earlier letters, ask the photo expert of the NAS to describe the photos, change nothing in Photos, and save one text file after you approve. Names come only from your notes. The time per photo depends on the NAS model and has not been measured yet. You read the whole letter, say save, then confirm once more if Uliya asks.

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. Write every straight apostrophe in returned names, paths and lines as ’. If the photo service is unhealthy, return failed and why. Use the photo folder if it is not none, otherwise the album whose name matches exactly. Use only a regular, folder, condition or custom album, never a face, baby, pet, object, location or city album; if only such an album matches, return no results. If several match, return at most 5 with their real UUID and photo count, and stop. Return the real name, album UUID or folder path, and photo count. If nothing matches, return no results with the closest search suggestions. Change nothing. Values: album = Christmas; photo folder = none.'

delegate --target photo-agent --instruction 'Read only. A ’ may be a straight apostrophe; try both. Write every straight apostrophe in returned names, paths and lines as ’. List still photos only, without videos and the screenshot category, paging through as many items as the photo count, sorted by capture time, oldest first. If the start time is not none, keep only photos taken after it, and leave out the already listed paths. If more remain than the limit, apply selection rule 1: keep the oldest and the newest, spread the rest evenly by position, and if a pick shares its minute with the pick before it, take the next photo in a later minute while one remains. Read their metadata in one call. Return the number of photos that qualified before the limit, the number kept, the newest capture time kept as year-month-day hour:minute:second, and per chosen photo, oldest first, P number, capture date and time, camera or file as its time source, the city, area or venue name or none, and the real file path. No street, house number or coordinates. Without capture times, say capture order unknown and newest time unknown. If no still photo remains, say no results. Change nothing. Values: album = Christmas 2024; album UUID or photo folder = 8e4d1c7b-3a9f-4b2e-9c6d-2f1a0b8e7d53; photo count = 22; limit = 6; start time = none; already listed = none.'
